description: The highly requested brown butter chocolate chip cookie recipe 🍪🍫🧈 Absolutely! Here’s the recipe from the image: 🍪 Brown Butter Cookies Ingredients 	•	280g salted butter 	•	1 cup brown sugar 	•	1 cup white sugar 	•	2 eggs 	•	Vanilla, to taste 	•	1 teaspoon baking soda 	•	¼ teaspoon baking powder 	•	3 cups all-purpose flour Instructions 	1.	Brown the butter (about 15 minutes), then let it cool slightly. 	2.	In a bowl, combine the white sugar and brown sugar with the melted brown butter. 	3.	Add the eggs and vanilla, and mix until well combined. 	4.	Add the flour, baking soda, and baking powder to the mixture. Mix until just combined (do not overmix). 	5.	Chill the dough for at least 2 hours. 	6.	Preheat your oven to 170–175°C. 	7.	Roll the dough into balls, place on a baking tray, and bake for 10–12 minutes. 	8.	Let the cookies cool for 10 minutes before enjoying. 🍪 #dayinmylife #spendthedaywithme #cookie #recipes #baking
